topic: Data access and sandbox setup for Brazil
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on data access methods for Brazilian data, specifically whether to import production data into the sandbox or establish a dedicated sandbox network connection. It was noted that someone had already uploaded data to production and requested it from Galina. A decision was made regarding the setup of direct sandbox access from the main VPN: while technically advisable, this access should not be granted to Galina at this time to prevent confusion, unless an explicit need arises.

[p3] confirmed that Galina already has access to the main VPN.
decisions: Do not grant Galina direct sandbox access from the main VPN until necessary.
